public_rationale: The reviewed research documents image-generation weaknesses, but weaknesses alone do not establish that previously undiscussed prompts perform worse than comparable publicized prompts. The available comparisons do not control the key differences between the prompt sets. Neither the asserted gap nor its implication about the internal mechanism is settled.
limitations: Requiring comparable difficulty is an evaluator interpretation that affects the result.
The cited research is context from an earlier period.
No evidence of a matched gap was found; that does not demonstrate equal performance.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-4o succeeds on previously discussed prompts but does worse on new ones, suggesting its compositional ability is far from robust.

statement.excerpt: In the particular case, we know that the system succeeds at previously-discussed prompts but does less well on ones not previously-discussed. That tells us something about the internal mechanism, and suggests that it is far from robust.

from_speaker: does less well on ones not previously-discussed
suggests that it is far from robust
our_interpretation: The system means the GPT-4o image generator discussed in the post.
The ordinary reading is a meaningful performance gap between previously publicized compositional prompts and comparable new prompts.
Comparability requires accounting for prompt difficulty, number of requested relationships, retries, and output selection. Otherwise a difference cannot establish the asserted generalization gap.
For the ongoing state without a specified reporting period, use July 1 through July 9, 2025: the latest partial calendar month at publication. This is an evaluator-selected reporting window.
The statement about robustness is a qualified inference. It does not establish that memorization or training contamination caused any observed gap.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous tests of the same GPT-4o image generator show meaningfully worse compositional accuracy on comparable previously undiscussed prompts, with failures supporting the stated concern about robustness.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Adequately comparable contemporaneous tests show no meaningful disadvantage on new prompts, or show that the claimed gap disappears when difficulty and testing procedures are matched.
